reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped R record of frozen Python 1.2 FDApy IrregularArgvals and IrregularValues constructor inputs with exact zero-based numeric row keys, selected-channel observations and individual sample times, no interpolation. Not an actual FDApy.IrregularFunctionalData instance or certified complete backend parity.
native_language_semantic_policy: Real native R retained scientific constructor arrays; Python optional backend class identity, attributes, methods, exceptions and estimator equivalence deliberately excluded. Original native R behavior remains default.

case_evidence.description: Frozen public to_fdapy_irregular(trajectories,*,dimension) validates selected numeric channel, then constructs IrregularArgvals of DenseArgvals({input_dim_0: time.copy()}) and IrregularValues of selected curve[:,index].copy(), keyed 0..n-1.

Native R irregular TrajectorySet with one or more curves, at least two sorted finite times per curve, finite selected channel, other channels may be missing. Historical R fdapace adapter still uses separate >=3 sample restrictions.

Full unchanged per-curve coordinate and selected value arrays, original input curve ordering, source index zero-based mapping, observed sample counts, exact channel index and no pooled grid or interpolation.

Reject invalid native irregular record, unknown dimension, nonfinite selected measurements, nonlogical strict flag or invalid time arrays. Python FDApy ImportError, nonnative coercions and backend class exceptions remain different.

Typed native R etr_fdapy_irregular_scientific_record with zero-based keys, named R argvals/values lists and exact source constructor class names; no actual Python FDApy IrregularFunctionalData object.
Lossless irregular functional data container conversion only: no smoothing, interpolation, PACE estimation, covariance inference or FDApy UFPCA fit.

independent_review_status: Provisional six-domain developer-authored scientific constructor audit. No independently certified full contract; executable exact-head R/Python qualification pending.
language_specific_limits: No Python FDApy IrregularFunctionalData class/attributes/methods or object identity.
R character-key named lists preserve numeric key values separately but do not become Python dict integer-key objects.
FDApy sparse UFPCA and Python backend errors not implemented or independently certified.
